title: output/needs-you.json: what only the editor can do for this client (the twin of output/NEEDS-YOU.md)
description: Written by `reel needs-you --write` (3.0 T4.7) from the client's state, never authored by hand; the panel (Phase 6) shows the same list. Producers put `needs_you: [{kind, text, text_ar?, why, ref}]` in their own state file; this file aggregates them with the items derived from today's state, deduplicated on (source, kind, ref). An empty `items` list means nothing needs the editor. Check with `reel validate output/needs-you.json`.

schema_version.description: the version of this schema the file follows

counts.description: items per kind (only the kinds present)

unread.description: state files that exist but could not be read: the list may be missing items

skipped.description: producer items that could not be shown (wrong shape, unknown kind, a ref outside the client folder)

kind.description: every item is for the editor (this file lists what only the editor can do), so no `who` field; verse = a recited Quran verse the editor adds by hand (manual verse), never with its words

ref.description: a client-root-relative path (forward slashes) or a plan id (graphic or scene id)

ref_exists.description: path refs only: the path exists now

item.description: the video, reel or episode id; null = the whole client

source.description: the client-root-relative state file it came from

span.description: verse items only: the recited span (ms; start/end on the reel's timeline, src_* in the source clip), its cue as shown and whether its end is a guess (no pause within 12 s). `ref` is the span id in the timeline spec's manual_verse list
